note: What Discovery must produce. No entry refers to the legacy compiler; `adjudicated_winner` is provenance about how the fixture was obtained and no assertion reads it.

cases.input: Each month I hold whichever of US stocks, international stocks or bonds had the best 12-month return, past 5 years.
cases.why: 'each month' is a rebalancing cadence and 'past 5 years' is the window. A reader that folds the cadence into the window answers a different question.

cases.input: Convert enough of my traditional IRA to a Roth each year to fill the 12% bracket, past 5 years.
cases.why: Two accounts in named roles with a direction. Reporting either end as a scalar `account_type` states half the sentence as if it were all of it.

cases.input: I hold a core index fund and tilt 30% satellite into US value ETF in a taxable brokerage account, over the past 5 years.
cases.why: Two sleeves in different roles, and the 30% belongs to one of them. A flat asset list can only say which weight is whose by position.

cases.input: I hold 60% VTI and 40% BND and rebalance once a year, past 5 years, starting with $50,000.
cases.why: The sentence names both holdings. Reporting one is a recall miss on the dimension where a miss is most expensive: a portfolio read as a single holding is not the portfolio described.

cases.input: I hold 100-stock sample directly in a taxable brokerage account tracking the index within TE <=1%, over the past 5 years.
cases.why: 'ETF' is a wrapper the sentence mentions, not a holding it names. Extracting it as an instrument prices something nobody described.

cases.input: I buy $1,000 of SPY whenever it crosses below its 200-day moving average, over the past five years.
cases.why: A different failure class from a recall miss. The hosted reader read this field correctly on a near-identical sentence in the same run and did not report it here, so what is being pinned is consistency: the same kind of evidence must produce the same reading. Absent is as wrong as persistent_condition — a dimension silently dropped is a dimension the engine will default, and this is the field whose misreading was worth 4.6x the money.
